verdict.rationale: Codegen has an agent-behavior settings page with a mode where agents present a structured plan of each step (codegen-docs-22). It also has permission toggles for actions such as PR creation (codegen-docs-32, codegen-docs-24) and a resume endpoint for paused runs (codegen-docs-35). Together these suggest configurable confirmation versus autonomous execution, but this is only inferred. Missing for 10: an explicit documented auto-approve / skip-confirmation setting, a clear description of which actions need confirmation by default, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
